subject: Private Deployment licensing & $/1M token target — post-demo follow-up
body:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Simon Hart <simon.hart@cloudserve.com>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 15 Mar 2026 14:02:00 -0700
Subject: Private Deployment licensing & $/1M token target — post-demo follow-up

Hi Simon — thanks again for the demo today. Quick recap and next steps from our side so we’re aligned: 

Summary of CloudServe requirements (as discussed):
- Deployment: Private (VPC) with 3 environments (dev/staging/prod); prod requires HA and dedicated capacity.
- Target throughput: 500 concurrent inference sessions, 1,000 qps peak for short requests (avg seq len ~128 tokens).
- Monthly token footprint: currently estimated at 120M–200M tokens/month, with growth scenario up to ~1B tokens over 12 months.
- Security/compliance: SOC 2 Type II required; procurement will want KMS integration and audit logs.
- Support: 24x7 coverage desired; prefer Platinum enterprise support for initial 12 months.

Cost/price qualifications I want to confirm with you:
1) Target unit economics: you mentioned the target was in the ballpark of $X per 1M tokens — can you confirm a target $/1M tokens range (or a budget band) for the first-year committed volume?
2) Licensing preference: are you looking for an annual license (per-environment or per-node) + per-token overage, or would a usage-only model (hosted-like) be preferable for procurement?
3) Environment count: are dev and staging allowed to be lower-tier (shared) vs prod dedicated?
4) Procurement timeline and PO cadence — any deadlines we should be aware of?

Proposed next steps:
- You send the desired $/1M token target and confirm licensing preference.
- We’ll prepare a draft pricing worksheet and SOW (example attached) reflecting both an annual licensing + overage model and an alternative commit-based credits model.
- Schedule a 30-min pricing walkthrough Thursday (I can do 9–11am PT).

Attachments: redwood_private_pricing_sheet_v2.xlsx (pricing scenarios), SOC2-summary.pdf (compliance snapshot).

Thanks — I’ll wait for the numbers you can share to make the pricing examples concrete.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai | (415) 555-0123

--

From: Simon Hart <simon.hart@cloudserve.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Procurement Team <procurement@cloudserve.com>
Date: Mon, 16 Mar 2026 09:24:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Private Deployment licensing & $/1M token target — post-demo follow-up

Marissa — thanks for the detailed recap. Quick answers inline: 

> 1) Target unit economics: you mentioned the target was in the ballpark of $X per 1M tokens — can you confirm a target $/1M tokens range (or a budget band) for the first-year committed volume?

Our CFO and product team are targeting $400–$750 per 1M tokens as the ballpark for model inference (this is for the private deployment total cost to our P&L). We are flexible depending on commitment/discounts for an annual contract. In year 1 we can commit to ~300M tokens/mo as a conservative baseline, but expect burst up to 1B tokens/mo in peak quarters.

> 2) Licensing preference: are you looking for an annual license (per-environment or per-node) + per-token overage, or would a usage-only model (hosted-like) be preferable for procurement?

Procurement will prefer a predictable, committed-cost structure. They don’t like pay-as-you-go for primary production spend. So either an annual license covering prod capacity + per-token overage, or a reserved-capacity credits model is what we’d consider. We need clear upgrade paths for additional environments.

> 3) Environment count: are dev and staging allowed to be lower-tier (shared) vs prod dedicated?

Yes — dev and staging can be shared or smaller instances. Prod must be dedicated and have automated failover.

> 4) Procurement timeline and PO cadence — any deadlines we should be aware of?

We’re aiming to finalize vendor selection by end of Q2 (June). Procurement prefers a 60–90 day procurement cycle. We may need a draft commercial term sheet to start internal approval flows.

Simon Hart
Head of Product | CloudServe Inc
simon.hart@cloudserve.com

--

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Simon Hart <simon.hart@cloudserve.com>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 17 Mar 2026 08:11:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Private Deployment licensing & $/1M token target — post-demo follow-up

Thanks Simon — that range and commitment picture is super helpful. I attached the pricing worksheet that lays out two primary options:

Option A — Annual license + capacity tiers
- Annual platform license per prod environment (covers dedicated nodes + HA)
- Staging/dev at reduced license rate (or shared)
- Token consumption beyond committed baseline is billed monthly at a pre-negotiated overage $/1M tokens with volume breakpoints

Option B — Reserved credits (commit) model
- Prepaid credits representing token units; discount increases with larger annual commits
- Credits consumed across environments; extra credits purchased at published rate

I’ll have Aditya run some rough per-node sizing to map your 300M–1B token scenarios to required GPU counts and the resulting cost figures. Neha, can you build two-side commercial examples: 300M/mo baseline vs 1B/mo growth showing list price, 15% mid-market discount, and a deeper strategic discount if they sign an annual enterprise support add-on?

Next actions:
- Simon: confirm whether procurement prefers an MSA + SOW (we usually do MSA + SOW) or a single contract doc.
- Simon: confirm preferred date/time for a 30-min pricing walkthrough. I’m available Thu 3/19 9–11am PT.
- Neha/Aditya: I’ll need the draft pricing scenarios by Wed EOD so I can include them in the walkthrough.

Regards,
Marissa

(attachment: redwood_private_pricing_sheet_v2.xlsx)

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 18 Mar 2026 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: Internal: pricing ask — CloudServe (prep for Thu walkthrough)

Team — copying the thread below. Key ask from Simon: target $400–$750 per 1M tokens and commit baseline ~300M/mo, growth to 1B/mo. Procurement wants predictable spend (leaning toward annual license + overage or reserved credits). They want 3 envs (dev/staging/prod) with prod dedicated. SOC 2 + KMS required.

Aditya — please: 
- Produce two sizing runs (300M/mo and 1B/mo) with node counts, expected latency at 128 tokens, and monthly compute ops. Include an estimate for prefix/KV caching benefits (we can cite 20–30% effective token reduction if they use cache).

Neha — please: 
- Produce two commercial tables (A: Annual license + overage; B: Reserved credits) with list, 15% mid-market, and 25% strategic discounts (the latter conditional on enterprise support + 12-mo commit). Show net $/1M tokens under each scenario for both volumes.

I’ll assemble into the worksheet and send to Simon ahead of the walkthrough.

Thanks — Marissa
